items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: Everett Barksdale, he was with us at one time

ctx.x: Did you -- who were some of the other guys that you remember who liked the cards?

Well, of course, guitarists like Tiny, Tiny used to play with us, and Everett Barksdale, he was with us at one time, John Collins. And quite a few other musicians at times when we were at one or the other's house, you know, had a little party or something, you know, start playing cards, because that was, oh, Art Tatum's favorite sport-like, you might say.
